items.heading: Grapevine Daily Quote November 19
items.text: In AA we aim not only for sobriety – we try again to become citizens of the world that we rejected, and of the world that once rejected us.
items.attribution: AA Co-Founder, Bill W., as quoted in April 1998, “Citizens of the World”, AA Grapevine

items.heading: Cita Diaria con La Viña Noviembre 19
items.text: Creo que la mentalidad abierta es uno de los principios espirituales fundamentales del programa .... Sin ella, no me es posible cambiar.
items.attribution: “Revelación práctica”. SAN FRANCISCO, CALIFORNIA, AGOSTO DE 1995
